findings.statement: Review 1 F-1 and F-2 are closed: tasks.md 1.2 rewrites the SCN-RL-004/SCN-RL-006 tests that accepted 2^53+1, and REQ-RL-001 now puts int/float subclasses that override float conversion or equality outside the contract. One leftover: under design D-2 and task 1.2, the test tagged SCN-RL-006 will check that a source value of 2^53+1 raises ValueError and that 2^53 and 2^53+12 are accepted. SCN-RL-006 does not describe either behaviour; only SCN-RL-007 does. So the test token does not trace to the scenario whose behaviour the test checks.
findings.recommendation: Tag the rewritten source-value test with SCN-RL-007 (alone or as well as SCN-RL-006), or add the 2^53+1 source case to the SCN-RL-006 scenario text.

assumptions.statement: Python semantics were inferred without running code. int==float compares exactly. float(2^53+1) is 2^53. float(int beyond max double) raises OverflowError. In SCN-RL-007 (2^53+2)-2^53 is exactly 2.0, so the refilled stock is 1.4 and the request passes.

Apart from the W rule and the source-value rule, the delta REQ-RL-001 and scenarios SCN-RL-001/003/004/006 match the main spec verbatim. Review 4 findings F-2..F-8 and review 1 F-3 (the UNK-RL-001 id reuse, which proposal.md documents) are unchanged by this text and are not repeated.
src/rate_limiter/__init__.py and tests/test_rate_limiter.py were read at the current HEAD, outside items[], as context for design and tasks.
